title: Referral letter
description: A letter in which a doctor refers a patient to this clinic. Only the administrative details below are extracted, never anything about the patient's health or the reason for the referral.

fields.name: patient_name
fields.description: The full name of the person being referred, as printed.

fields.name: date_of_birth
fields.description: The date of birth of the person being referred.

fields.name: referring_doctor
fields.description: The name of the doctor who wrote and signed the referral, as printed.

fields.name: referral_date
fields.description: The date on which the referral letter was written.

fields.name: insurer
fields.description: The name of the insurance company the letter names for this person, if any.

fields.name: policy_number
fields.description: The insurance policy number the letter gives for this person, if any, as written.
